newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end sharply down on sparse turnover.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end sharply down on sparse turnover.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed sharply lower on Monday, brokers said.
They said the losses in the Nikkei average, brought about mostly by bouts of arbitrage-linked selling throughout the day, were magnified by the low trading volume.
The 225-Nikkei average tumbled 345.06 points, or 1.63 percent, to settle at 20,883.74. September futures were down 300 points at 20,910.
"The end of the month is approaching and important economic indicators are due out this week, keeping participants away," said Masaaki Higashida, strategist at Nomura Securities.
